headlines.article_text: Stock market today: Live updates Skip Navigation Markets Business Investing Tech Politics & Policy Video Watchlist Investing Club PRO Livestream Menu Traders work on the floor of the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) at the opening bell in New York City on November 10, 2026. Angela Weiss | Afp | Getty Images Stock futures rose slightly on Tuesday night following a losing session in which Nvidia, coupled with hotter-than-expected inflation data, pressured the broader market. Dow Jones Industrial Average futures gained 88 points, or 0.2%. S&P 500 futures climbed 0.2%, while Nasdaq-100 futures advanced 0.4%. In Asia, Japan's Nikkei 225 traded 0.85% higher on Wednesday. South Korea's Kospi was up 1.22%, while Australia's S&P/ASX 200 added 0.23%. Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index is down 0.66%, while the CSI 300 is down 0.39%. The Dow pulled back more than 150 points in regular trading, while the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite shed 0.4% and 0.7%, respectively. At the center of the decline was Nvidia . The chipmaker pulled back 5.5%, as CEO Jensen Huang's affair with an alleged Chinese spy weighed on the stock for the second consecutive session. Nvidia's two-day slide pulled the company's market cap down to around $4.07 trillion, its lowest since late March. Equities also fell on Tuesday after the latest U.S. inflation data solidified expectations for a December Federal Reserve rate hike. The consumer price index increased by 0.4% month over month in October , topping expectations.
